headline: Approved broker search for former SAU building at 18 South Main Street and appointed Kathy Kennedy as school district treasurer at $2,000 salary.
summary: Principals reported on the start of the school year. The consent agenda was approved, along with a request for qualifications for the former SAU building and a new treasurer. Administrators also discussed budget planning, athletic busing, and a proposed statewide tax cap.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including a $4,797,499.02 manifest, $3,578,509.90 general payroll, and $1,218,989.12 general expense, 5-0.

Approved the request for qualifications process for commercial real estate brokerage services for the former SAU property at 18 South Main Street, and authorized the Superintendent to issue the RFQ subject to legal review, 6-0.
Appointed Kathy Kennedy as School District Treasurer for a term through June 30, 2029, at an annual salary of $2,000, 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board approved the Public Meeting Minutes of August 25, 2026; the Nonpublic Meeting Minutes of August 25, 2026; a Manifest in the amount of $4,797,499.02; $3,578,509.90 General Payroll; and $1,218,989.12 General Expense.

Brenda Willis Moved for the School Board to approve the proposed request for qualifications process for commercial real estate brokerage services related to the former SAU property at 18 South Main Street and authorized the Superintendent to finalize and issue the RFQ subject to legal review. ... Vote: Yes - Unanimous (6/0)

Jenna Paradise Moved to appoint Kathy Kennedy as School District Treasurer for a term through June 30, 2029, at an annual salary of $2,000. Jennifer Theroux seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes - Unanimous (6/0)
